title: Parity pairs evaluate to input parity
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $x$ assign Boolean values to its variables. The exclusive-or accumulated over the list of pairs consisting, for each variable, of its positive and negative literal evaluates to the exclusive-or of the input values, accumulated over all variable indices with false as the initial value.
